name: Comprehensive Campaign Management - Advanced Campaign Lifecycle System

parameters.jsCode:
// Format campaign data for Google Sheets storage
const campaignData = $input.first().json;

// Prepare row data in the correct order for Google Sheets
const rowData = [
  campaignData.id,
  campaignData.name,
  campaignData.description,
  campaignData.type,
  campaignData.difficulty,
  campaignData.status,
  campaignData.visibility,
  campaignData.dmId,
  campaignData.maxPlayers,
  campaignData.minPlayers,
  JSON.stringify(campaignData.players),
  JSON.stringify(campaignData.waitingList),
  JSON.stringify(campaignData.playerApplications),
  JSON.stringify(campaignData.partyComposition),
  JSON.stringify(campaignData.sessionSchedule),
  JSON.stringify(campaignData.worldBuilding),
  JSON.stringify(campaignData.progressMilestones),
  campaignData.currentMilestone,
  campaignData.overallProgress,
  JSON.stringify(campaignData.mainQuestline),
  JSON.stringify(campaignData.completedQuests),
  JSON.stringify(campaignData.statistics),
  JSON.stringify(campaignData.settings),
  campaignData.createdAt,
  campaignData.lastUpdated,
  JSON.stringify(campaignData.tags),
  campaignData.notes
];

return {
  json: {
    range: 'Campaigns!A:Z',
    values: [rowData]
  }
};
